topicA: AI Search Visibility and Answer Engine Optimization

recap.intro: Welcome back, future B2B marketing leaders! This week you explored two fascinating areas of B2B marketing: how AI is changing search visibility and how businesses are getting ready for and transforming with AI.
bullets: Answer engines are now like "billboards" that actively create interest and demand for brands, influencing decisions early on.
AI is a powerful tool, but it's not a magic solution for company changes; clear goals and a strategy are still crucial.
Measuring AI search visibility is complex because being cited by an AI doesn't always mean a recommendation, and click data is hard to track.
Many businesses struggle with AI because their existing data isn't organized or clean enough for these new tools to work effectively.
recap.closing: This week you learned that successful B2B AI adoption requires more than just technology; it demands strategic planning, clean data, and a new way of measuring impact.
